summary: Defines how chunk flags in the Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP) are registered with IANA, and creates a registry for the flags of currently defined chunk types. It does not change how SCTP works. It updates RFC 4960 and was replaced by RFC 9260.

eli5.summary: SCTP sends data in little pieces that carry tiny on-off switches. This sets up an official list so nobody picks the same switch for two different meanings.

questions: how to register sctp chunk flags
